thread:
incident-bot: Pager - P1 GPU capacity alert in ap-northeast3. Autoscaler failed to provision GPUs (quotaExceeded). Queue length: ~1200, new requests piling. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.local/gpu-quotahit.
Julie Chen: I'm on call, pulling infra. Early ask: how bad is customer impact right now?
Samir Patel: Hosted API /v1/generate 5xxs up ~20%, median latency x3. Dedicated customers look ok. Autoscaler logs show AWS error: InstanceLimitExceeded / quotaExceeded when launching g4dn instances.
Nisha Kumar: Confirming via AWS Service Quotas API - GPU instance type g4dn.* returns limit=0 in ap-northeast-3 for this account (soft cap / propagation issue). Opening support case now.
Matt O'Leary: Quick mitigation options: 1) failover routing to nearby region (ap-northeast1 / asia-east1), 2) drop concurrency for noncritical customer routes, 3) evict non-urgent batch workloads, 4) enable CPU fallback for low-priority traffic. Recommend routing + concurrency drop to buy time.
Samir Patel: Agreed. I'll patch traffic routing to shift ~40% to ap-northeast1 and immediately reduce per-model concurrency from 4->2 for hosted tier. Doing deploy now.
Julie Chen: Nisha please paste support ticket ID and ETA once you have it. I'll coordinate customer comms for accounts hitting errors.
Nisha Kumar: AWS case opened: case-20240514-98765. Escalation requested (billing/ad-hoc softlimit). AWS ETA quoted 4h for quota change; escalated to Priority-1. Also submitted online quota increase: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=ap-northeast-3 (link).
autoscaler-bot: Autoscaler attempt 2024-05-14T09:22:41Z -> failed: LaunchTemplate(g4dn-x) error: InstanceLimitExceeded (quotaExceeded). Next retry in 30s.
Matt O'Leary: Routing change applied at 2024-05-14T09:25Z via infra/route-manager. Snippet: ```kubectl patch configmap traffic-routes -p '{"data":{"hosted":"ap-northeast1:40,ap-northeast3:60"}}'``` Reduced concurrency for hosted models: patched config /models/hosted/* concurrency=2.
Julie Chen: Customer impact summary (initial): 6 accounts reporting degraded throughput; 2 accounts escalated to SEs. Public status: posting degraded-service banner.
Samir Patel: Monitoring update: queue length dropped 1200 -> 700 in 8m after routing + concurrency changes. 5xxs down to ~8%. Keeping autoscaler retry loop enabled but likely blocked until quota bumps.
Nisha Kumar: Support updated: AWS escalated to capacity team, expected callback in ~2h with potential temporary quota lift. Ticket: case-20240514-98765.
Matt O'Leary: Short-term additional mitigation: killing noncritical nightly batch run (job-id batch-20240514-03) freed 4 GPUs. That shaved queue a bit.
Julie Chen: Noting actions and impact. Handoff: Samir will own night oncall (start 2024-05-14T22:00Z). If AWS hasn't resolved in +2h from now, escalate to Eng VP and prepare customer credits plan.
Samir Patel: Acknowledged handoff. Alerts muted for noncritical noise; oncall channel remains open. I'll post final postmortem stub after incident closes.
cloud-support: Created support doc with links to logs and routing diff: https://support.redwood.local/cases/case-20240514-98765. Added estimated timeline and contacts.
Julie Chen: Thanks team — keep updates concise. Leaving thread open for handoff notes and final RCA.
